[head=2][color=#e8b04b]Radio and Channel Keys[/color][/head]
Press [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="FocusRadioWindow"/][/color] to start a radio message. To use a specific channel, put its prefix at the beginning: [color=#6ab7d6]:o Reporting in at the dock.[/color]
You can only transmit on channels installed in your headset. If a prefix does not work, examine the headset and ask your supervisor which network your role uses.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Common and civilian channels[/color][/head]
- [bold]Common[/bold] uses [color=#6ab7d6];[/color] and appears in chat as [bold]Longwave 2.5km[/bold]. It is useful for nearby civilian coordination but may be heard by many factions. - [bold]Traffic[/bold] uses [color=#6ab7d6]:d[/color] and appears as [bold]Shortwave 500m[/bold]. It is short-ranged and carried by far fewer headsets. - Gliess Santo and Colonial Minutemen roles use [color=#6ab7d6]:s[/color], shown as [bold]Gliessian Sheriffs[/bold]. Their headset also carries Traffic. Visitors without that headset use Common unless directed otherwise. - The Taypani-Atyrian Pact channel, [bold]The Atyrian Pact[/bold], uses [color=#6ab7d6]:4[/color].
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Faction channels[/color][/head]
- [color=#684871]DSM[/color]: Imperial command [color=#6ab7d6]:i[/color]; Imperial civilian [color=#6ab7d6]:j[/color]. - [color=#bf4d00]NCWL[/color]: faction [color=#6ab7d6]:o[/color]; command [color=#6ab7d6]:h[/color]. - [color=#535961]SHI[/color]: corporate [color=#6ab7d6]:w[/color]. - [color=#ff7f7f]TFCF[/color]: Federation-wide [color=#6ab7d6]:t[/color] (still labelled [bold]Syndicate[/bold] in chat); command [color=#6ab7d6]:7[/color] ([bold]TFCF Command[/bold]). - TFCF company channels: Gorlex [color=#6ab7d6]:p[/color], Cyberdawn [color=#6ab7d6]:2[/color], Interdyne [color=#6ab7d6]:3[/color], and SAW [color=#6ab7d6]:x[/color]. - [color=#8b1a1a]Saint's Militia[/color]: the hunt channel [color=#6ab7d6]:a[/color], shown as [bold]Saint's Militia Hunt[/bold]. Only the Militia's midround spawns carry it.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Radio discipline[/color][/head]
- [color=#d9776c]A faction channel is not perfectly secure.[/color] Captured headsets and encryption keys can let an enemy listen. - In combat, give your location, the threat, direction of travel, and what help you need. Keep calls short enough for others to answer. - Confirm important orders. If you do not understand an instruction, ask instead of silently guessing.
